title: Beatrix and the Thorn Revisited
author: Sebastian Nystrom
blurb: Coral Zhou, a thief who steals memories, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
